column3: Exact parallel of preferring the worldly life; it also keeps an exclusive-possession reading in view.
Counter-reading: manifest evidence and the originator outweigh a ruler whose judgment reaches only this worldly life.
Frames worldly life as deceptive beside a true promise, clarifying the risk in treating its appeal as decisive.
Identifies fixation on the worldly surface and heedlessness of the later horizon as a constricted field of attention.

Directly joins turning from remembrance with wanting only the worldly life.

Links worldly-life deception with derision toward divine signs and an irreversible outcome.
